metadata.notes: Real georeferenced OSM street centerlines and building footprints. Unsurveyed heights are deterministic visual estimates. Only the largest connected public-street graph is navigable; secondary disconnected visual roads remain visible. Roads are simplified to approximately 2m tolerance. Navigation is clipped to the playable 8,000-unit square.
